consistency.reason: Coherent arch-pattern cards, plain label bands, offset pale shadows and thin directional arrows recur across every ratio. Branches, grids, stacks and portrait flow adapt correctly to the briefs. The repeated card treatment makes ratios coherent, but distinct composition and texture treatment are limited; the portrait availability note loses clarity.

character.reason: Recognizable layered-paper geometry, inset arch texture, overlapping label panels and slim curved connectors are retained. Useful subject-specific clocks, checkmarks and empty-box geometry are present. Compared with the originals, sheets are more regularly aligned and arch openings are often elongated; collage depth and large overlapping paper variation are reduced. The shared repeated card construction does not reach the expressive variation required for 4.

losses: Strong rotation and varied sheet overlaps of original collage are subdued

Large central layered assembly is replaced by mostly uniform node cards

batch.factualSummary: No invented fees, people, countdowns, automatic approval, failure state, fine or refusal observed. Counts and route directions are preserved. Return-box usability is conveyed by route but its small explicit note is difficult to read.

uncertainty.font: Raster inspection shows readable Japanese glyphs and a consistent sans-serif appearance; actual Noto Sans CJK JP selection, fallback use and font provenance cannot be established from PNGs alone. No missing-glyph boxes observed.
uncertainty.scale: Captures are larger placement frames: 688x416, 408x336, 528x456, 768x336 and 368x576. Target artwork dimensions are those supplied by dispatch/briefs. Reviewed the actual PNGs at their native image dimensions without enlarging them; placement metadata was outside the allowed scope, so exact CSS/device scale and artwork bounds are not independently verified.
